paragraphs.text: Horse is a creature type used for cards that depict equine creatures . In addition to horses, it encompasses the tarpan and hipparion , which are extinct relatives of the modern horse, and some horse-shaped elemental creatures. Several other creature types exist for related creatures, including Centaur , Kirin , Noggle , Pegasus , Unicorn , and the acorn types Donkey , Pony , and Alicorn .
Horses are found in roughly equal proportions across all colors .
The first creature printed with the type Horse was Zodiac Horse in Portal Three Kingdoms .

The use of the Horse type for horse-like elemental creatures is somewhat inconsistent. For example, Thundermare and Timbermare have the Horse type (via errata ), but Spitemare and Wispmare do not. As early as 2007, Doug Beyer noted the tension between the latter cards and the rule within R&D that a card's name and creature types should agree. By 2017, that rule had been discarded.
Akroan Horse is a reference to the Trojan Horse .

Several cards printed before 2008 received errata to use the Horse type in the Grand Creature Type Update , including the only card printed with the pony type, Dwarven Pony ( Homelands ). Pony was later printed as an acorn type in Secret Lair Drop Series: Ponies: The Galloping 2 - Extra Life 2023 . Other types replaced by Horse in the Grand Creature Type Update include Carriage , Tarpan , Hipparion , and Thundermare .
